import hashlib,importlib,json,os,pathlib,sys
sys.path.insert(0,"/tmp")
driver=importlib.import_module("native_jax_bf16_splash_15b_separate_capture")
core=importlib.import_module("levanter.grug.attention._core")
levanter=importlib.import_module("levanter")
haliax=importlib.import_module("haliax")
root=pathlib.Path(os.environ["AB_EXPECTED_WORKTREE"]).resolve()
actual_core=pathlib.Path(core.__file__).resolve()
if actual_core!=root/"lib/levanter/src/levanter/grug/attention/_core.py":raise ValueError("Imported core from wrong source tree")
core_sha=hashlib.sha256(actual_core.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if core_sha!=os.environ["AB_EXPECTED_CORE_SHA"]:raise ValueError("Imported core file bytes differ")
barrier_present="optimization_barrier" in core._tpu_splash_attention.__code__.co_names
if barrier_present!=(os.environ["AB_VARIANT"]=="candidate"):raise ValueError("Actual imported Python function does not match barrier variant")
modules={"core":str(actual_core),"levanter":levanter.__file__,"haliax":haliax.__file__,"benchmark":driver.prior.bench.__file__}
for name in ["levanter","haliax","benchmark"]:
 if not pathlib.Path(modules[name]).resolve().is_relative_to(root):raise ValueError("Imported module from wrong source tree: "+name)
record_path=pathlib.Path(os.environ["AB_LAUNCH_RECORD"])
record=json.loads(record_path.read_text())
record["runtime_child_imports"]={"modules":modules,"core_sha256":core_sha,"actual_function_contains_barrier":barrier_present,"dont_write_bytecode":sys.dont_write_bytecode,"pycache_prefix":sys.pycache_prefix}
record_path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
driver.SOURCE=os.environ["SOURCE_COMMIT"]
driver.CAPTURE_HLO_TOTAL_LIMIT=12*1024*1024
driver.prior.HLO_TOTAL_LIMIT=16*1024*1024
sys.argv=[driver.__file__,*sys.argv[1:]]
driver.main()
